Aplicamos censo de perfil demográfico, pesquisas de percepção e autodiagnóstico coletivo das relações étnico-raciais e suas interseccionalidades.NA SOCIEDADEFazemos rodas de conversa, encontros de letramento racial, palestras e cursos livres sobre relações étnico-raciais e antirracismo. Também realizamos pesquisas e análise de dados e fazemos revisão e leitura crítica de materiais.Organizamos e conduzimos bancas de heteroidentificação, uma ação complementar à autodeclaração racial a fim de assegurar a credibilidade das políticas afirmativas.FILANTROPIAConduzimos rodas de conversa em instituições públicas ou organizações sem fins lucrativos.

AI handles the busywork while humans stay in the loop to guide decisions and drive the business forward.More than 170,000 organizations — including Accenture, Amazon, Anthropic, Morningstar, and Suzuki — run their most critical work on Asana.For more information, visit www.asana.com.

basic_info.name: monday.com
basic_info.description: Outpace everyone with the best AI work platform. monday.com brings people, workflows, and AI agents together on one platform, so teams can plan, execute, and deliver with exponential impact.monday sidekick is the digital worker that thinks with you, creates for you, and moves work forward. monday vibe lets you build custom business software in minutes. And monday agents multiply your team's capacity: an always-on AI workforce that handles specialized tasks across every department.From work management to CRM, dev, service, and campaigns, it all runs on one connected, context-aware platform.Trusted by 250,000+ customers, including over 60% of the Fortune 500, across 200+ countries.monday.com has offices in Tel Aviv, New York, Miami, Chicago, Denver, London, Warsaw, Sydney, Melbourne, São Paulo, and Tokyo.

basic_info.name: Jira Tutorial
basic_info.description: Jira Tutorials is an online platform that provides comprehensive training on Jira, a powerful project management tool used by teams worldwide. With Jira Tutorials, you can learn the fundamentals of Jira, including project management, issue tracking, and agile methodology. The platform offers a range of courses for beginners to advanced users, all taught by experienced instructors with real-world expertise. Jira Tutorials also provides hands-on projects and practical exercises to help learners apply their knowledge. Whether you're a project manager, software developer, or agile team member, Jira Tutorials has something for you to enhance your skills and boost your career.
